title: Close Encounter
description: A CLOSE ENCOUNTER of a different kind is portrayed in this painting (front). Darth Vader confronts Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia at the temple of Pomojema in the swamplands of Mimban, where they were searching for the all-powerful Kaiburr crystal. What? You don't remember that in the film? That's because the story is from "Splinter of the Mind's Eye" (back) the first follow up novel in the STAR WARS universe.
